_readme: Kling 4.0 on Higgsfield — the wired BACKUP behind Seedance: a clip goes here when Seedance fails its three takes, is refused or is down. Same shape as seedance-2.5.json.

SOURCES ARE FLAGGED. The model list (Higgsfield connector) is the vendor's own and read live. The prompt rules come from fal's and Higgsfield's Kling 3.0 guides (third party / the door's own blog); Kling's own prompt guide was not found. Kling 4.0's own guide has not been read: its rows below that say 'from Kling 3.0' are assumed to carry.

THE ONE FACT THAT SHAPES THE FALLBACK: no Kling model on Higgsfield takes an audio reference. Kling makes its own sound (dialogue from the prompt, ambience) or none. It cannot lip-sync our locked ElevenLabs read. A talking clip that falls back to Kling is therefore SILENT (sound off) and its line is laid under it as an off-camera read, not lip-synced. Said plainly in the ledger.
No brand, product, person or format word appears in this file.
label: Kling 4.0 (backup)

vendor_ids.higgsfield_path: kling-video/v4.0/image-to-video (the path pattern is from the Higgsfield video list; the exact request fields are read off the first live call)
vendor_ids.also: kling3_0 (3.0, std/pro/4k, 3 to 15 s), kling_o3_flf (first and last frame), kling_o3_image_reference (up to 7 reference pictures)

sources: [vendor, live] Higgsfield connector model list (models_explore get), read 2026-10-26
https://open.higgsfield.ai/explore/video (the Higgsfield video list: paths and prices)

limits.no_480p: Kling 4.0 has no 480p: the backup is made at 720p and upscaled on this Mac like every clip
limits.audio_reference: none: no Kling model on Higgsfield takes our audio
limits.price_per_second_usd: from 0.11 (list 0.157) at 4.0; from 0.042 (list 0.084) at 3.0 — Higgsfield list, not measured

house.mode: image-to-video from the approved start picture
house.duration: the clip's own length, 3 to 10 s
house.takes: the backup is the last rung: one attempt, scored like the others; the best-scoring attempt overall is kept (V34)

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.what: What happens and how the camera moves.
inputs.allowed: no stated limit; subject, action, camera, style, one action and one camera move per shot

inputs.name: start_image
inputs.what: The approved first picture; the model keeps its identity, layout and text.

inputs.name: end_image
inputs.what: A last picture the clip settles on; the prompt must describe motion that can reach it.
inputs.we_send: only on a silent clip with a different last picture

inputs.name: image_references
inputs.what: Pictures that fix a subject across the clip.
inputs.allowed: up to 7 on the 3.0 Omni model; element ids up to 7 on 4.0

inputs.name: video_references
inputs.what: A clip to take motion or edit from.

inputs.name: sound / audio
inputs.allowed: 3.0: on or off. 4.0 and 2.6: native audio. No audio INPUT on any Kling model

inputs.name: multi_shots / multi_prompt
inputs.what: A sequence of shots in one clip (3.0 Omni).
inputs.allowed: up to 5 shots, total at most 15 s, each {prompt, duration}

structure.rule: Cover subject, action, camera behaviour and visual style.
structure.ours: kling_prompt.build: subject and style sentence, action windows, camera line, constants

structure.rule: With a start picture, treat it as the anchor: describe only how the scene changes (movement, camera, environment), not what is already in it.
structure.ours: 'Image 1 anchors the clip' and the action windows only

structure.rule: One action and one camera move per shot; split several events across shots; do not pack many shots into a short clip.
structure.ours: windows of at least 2.5 s, one camera line

structure.rule: State the camera move explicitly (tracking, panning, staying in a medium shot, resuming smoothly); the model follows a described move through the clip.
structure.ours: CAMERA phrases from the shot's camera_move

structure.rule: Motion follows gravity, inertia and the environment; explicit motion descriptions reduce artifacts.
If an end frame is attached the prompt must describe motion that can plausibly reach it, else it drifts; simplify the prompt and let the frames carry direction.
structure.ours: an end picture only when different, motion kept simple

structure.rule: Close with locks and the few negatives ('no subtitles', 'no on-screen text').
(If native speech were used) give every speaker a unique label, put the action before the line, and tone cues per speaker. Not used: our voice is ours.
Draft at 720p, lock the prompt and structure, then render the final at the size needed; do not iterate at 4K.

avoid.text: Several actions or camera moves in one shot.
Vague camera or motion language in fast or continuous shots.
Motion that conflicts with an attached end frame.
Packing five shots into a short duration.
Pronoun-only or unlabeled speakers (if speech is ever used).
Expecting reference-video motion transfer from the base model: that is Kling Motion Control, a separate model.
Using Kling's native speech for a line that must be OUR voice: it will not be our read.

history.about: Kling 4.0 is the wired backup behind Seedance
